subject: Genetics
title: Newborn Screening Expands
description: A quick, practical guide to Newborn Screening Expands.

hook.text: Every baby born in the U.S. gets a heel-prick blood test. It screens for rare diseases. Genomics expands the list.

buildup.text: Standard newborn screening tests for 35 conditions. Genome sequencing could check thousands in one test.

discovery.text: The BabySeq project found that 10% of healthy newborns carry variants linked to childhood-onset conditions.

twist.text: Early detection saves lives—but also creates anxiety.

climax.text: The UK launched a 100,000-newborn sequencing pilot in 2023. The ethics are being written in real time.

punchline.text: Sequencing every baby is possible. Deciding what to tell parents isn't.

quiz.question: What did the BabySeq project find in healthy newborns?
